businesses.business: sales and marketing services for consumer goods brands and retailers

offering_description.value: Provides outsourced sales and marketing services to consumer goods manufacturers and retailers. Services include retail merchandising, headquarter sales representation, retail media, shopper and brand marketing, and e-commerce services. Delivered by field teams and account staff across many countries.

primary_services.value: retail merchandising; headquarter sales representation; brand and shopper marketing; retail media and e-commerce services; experiential marketing and demonstrations

customer_segment.value: B2B: consumer packaged goods manufacturers, brand owners and retailers such as grocery and mass merchants

end_markets.value: consumer packaged goods; grocery retail; mass merchandise retail; food and beverage; e-commerce

revenue_model.value: service fees: fees for merchandising, sales representation and marketing programs; commissions or management fees: commissions on sales brokerage and retainer fees for headquarter representation; project or contract: contracted marketing campaigns and retail programs
revenue_model.category: service fees; commissions or management fees; project or contract

value_chain_position.value: service provider: outsourced field and account teams serving manufacturers and retailers; financial intermediary: sales brokerage acting as agent between manufacturers and retailers

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada, Europe, Asia-Pacific and Latin America

specialization.value: related lines: sales services and marketing services for consumer goods, sharing customers and field workforce

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: account teams selling services directly to manufacturers and retailers

regulatory_exposure.value: low: general business, employment and advertising rules, some food retail handling and data privacy rules
